Morning Session - 2024 Meeting

In the morning session , Warren Buffett, and Berkshire Vice Chairmen Greg Abel and Ajit Jain discuss Berkshire's sale of 13% of its Apple stock holdings, the prospect of higher capital gains taxes, and what Buffett would have done with one more day with Charlie Munger before he died.

Secondly, it's also very difficult to have some sense of what we call lost cost, or the cost of goods sold, could potentially be. It's not just for a single loss, but for losses across over time.
